# Teak Room Interiors

> Luxury interior design studio based in Nilambur, Kerala, specializing in residential and commercial interiors and bespoke teak furniture. Serves Nilambur, Malappuram, Kozhikode, and Palakkad districts.

Teak Room Interiors offers space planning, 3D visualization, bespoke furniture design, and full interior execution. Based in Nilambur — home to Asia's oldest teak plantation — with direct access to genuine teak craftsmanship.

## Process
1. Engagement — understanding requirements and aesthetic preferences
2. Development — concept designs and mood boards
3. Approval — finalized layouts and materials via 3D renders
4. Implementation — execution with precision
5. Completion — final styling and delivery
